H3300.def: from «06213» and «0410»; made of God; Jaasiel, an Israelite:--Jaasiel, Jasiel.

H3301.def: from «06299» and «03050»; Jah will liberate; Jiphdejah, an Israelite:--Iphedeiah.

H3302.def: a primitive root; properly, to be bright, i.e. (by implication) beautiful:--be beautiful, be (make self) fair(-r), deck.

H3303.def: from «03302»; beautiful (literally or figuratively):--+ beautiful, beauty, comely, fair(-est, one), + goodly, pleasant, well.

H3304.def: from «03302» by reduplication; very beautiful:--very fair.

H3305.def: or Yaphow (Ezra 3:7) {yaw-fo'}; from «03302»; beautiful; Japho, a place in Palestine:--Japha, Joppa.

H3306.def: a primitive root; properly, to breathe hard, i.e. (by implication) to sigh:--bewail self.

H3307.def: from «03306»; properly, puffing, i.e. (figuratively) meditating:--such as breathe out.

H3309.def: from «03313»; bright; Japhia, the name of a Canaanite, an Israelite, and a place in Palestine:--Japhia.

H3310.def: from «06403»; he will deliver; Japhlet, an Israelite:--Japhlet.

H3311.def: patronymically from «03310»; a Japhletite or descendant of Japhlet:--Japhleti.

H3312.def: from «06437»; he will be prepared; Jephunneh, the name of two Israelites:--Jephunneh.

H3313.def: a primitive root; to shine:--be light, shew self, (cause to) shine (forth).

H3315.def: from «06601»; expansion; Jepheth, a son of Noah; also his posterity:--Japheth.

H3316.def: from «06605»; he will open; Jiphtach, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine:--Jephthah, Jiphtah.

H3317.def: from «06605» and «0410»; God will open; Jiphtach-el, a place in Palestine:--Jiphthah-el.

H3318.def: a primitive root; to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.:--X after, appear, × assuredly, bear out, × begotten, break out, bring forth (out, up), carry out, come (abroad, out, thereat, without), + be condemned, depart(-ing, -ure), draw forth, in the end, escape, exact, fail, fall (out), fetch forth (out), get away (forth, hence, out), (able to, cause to, let) go abroad (forth, on, out), going out, grow, have forth (out), issue out, lay (lie) out, lead out, pluck out, proceed, pull out, put away, be risen, × scarce, send with commandment, shoot forth, spread, spring out, stand out, × still, × surely, take forth (out),

H3320.def: a primitive root; to place (any thing so as to stay); reflexively, to station, offer, continue:--present selves, remaining, resort, set (selves), (be able to, can, with-) stand (fast, forth, -ing, still, up).

H3321.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «03320»; to be firm; hence, to speak surely:--truth.

H3322.def: a primitive root; to place permanently:--establish, leave, make, present, put, set, stay.

H3323.def: from «06671»; oil (as producing light); figuratively, anointing:--+ anointed oil.

H3324.def: the same as «03323»; Jitshar, an Israelite:--Izhar.

H3325.def: patronymically from «03324»; a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar:--Izeharites, Izharites.

H3326.def: passive participle of «03331»; spread, i.e. a bed; (architecture) an extension, i.e. wing or lean-to (a single story or collectively): -bed, chamber, couch.

H3327.def: from «06711»; laughter (i.e. mochery); Jitschak (or Isaac), son of Abraham:--Isaac. Compare «03446».

H3328.def: from the same as «06713»; he will shine; Jitschar, an Israelite:--and Zehoar (from the margin).

H3329.def: from «03318»; issue, i.e. offspring:--those that came forth.

H3330.def: (Aramaic) from «03321»; fixed, sure; concretely, certainty:--certain(-ty), true, truth.

H3331.def: a primitive root; to strew as a surface:--make (one's) bed, × lie, spread.

H3332.def: a primitive root; properly, to pour out (transitive or intransitive); by implication, to melt or cast as metal; by extension, to place firmly, to stiffen or grow hard:--cast, cleave fast, be (as) firm, grow, be hard, lay out, molten, overflow, pour (out), run out, set down, stedfast.

H3333.def: passive participle feminine of «03332»; poured out, i.e. run into a mould:--when it was cast.

H3334.def: a primitive root; to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress:--be distressed, be narrow, be straitened (in straits), be vexed.

H3335.et: probably identical with (03334) (through the squeezing into shape), ([compare (03331)])
H3335.def: probably identical with «03334» (through the squeezing into shape); ((compare «03331»)); to mould into a form; especially as a potter; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution):--X earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.

H3336.def: from «03335»; a form; figuratively, conception (i.e. purpose):--frame, thing framed, imagination, mind, work.

H3337.def: the same as «03336»; Jetser, an Israelite:--Jezer.

H3338.def: passive participle of «03335»; structure, i.e. limb or part:--member.ql

H3340.def: : patronymically from «03337»; a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendants of Jetser:--Jezerites.

H3341.def: a primitive root; to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate:--burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire ((fire)), kindle.

H3342.et: from an unused root meaning to excavate
H3342.def: from an unused root meaning to excavate; a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine-vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed):--fats, presses, press-fat, wine(-press).

H3343.def: from «06908» and «0410»; God will gather; Jekabtseel, a place in Palestine:--Jekabzeel. Compare «06909».

H3344.def: a primitive root; to burn:--(be) burn(-ing), × from the hearth, kindle.

H3347.def: from «03344» and «05971»; burning of (the) people; Jokdeam, a place in Palestine:--Jokdeam.

H3348.et: from an unused root probably meaning to obey
H3348.def: from an unused root probably meaning to obey; obedient; Jakeh, a symbolical name (for Solomon):--Jakeh.

H3349.def: from the same as «03348»; obedience: -gathering, to obey.

H3351.def: from «06965»; properly, standing (extant), i.e. by implication, a living thing:--(living) substance.

H3352.def: from «03369»; properly, entangling; hence, a snarer: -fowler.

H3353.def: passive participle of «03369»; properly, entangled, i.e. by implication (intransitively) a snare, or (transitive) a snarer:--fowler, snare.

H3354.def: from the same as «03348» and «0410»; obedience of God; Jekuthiel, an Israelite:--Jekuthiel.

H3355.def: from «06994»; he will be made little; Joktan, an Arabian patriarch:--Joktan.

H3356.def: from «06965»; he will raise; Jakim, the name of two Israelites:--Jakim. Compare «03079».

H3359.def: from «06965» and «03050»; Jah will rise; Jekamjah, the name of two Israelites:--Jekamiah. Compare «03079».

H3360.def: from «06965» and «05971»; (the) people will rise; Jekamam, an Israelite:--Jekameam. Compare «03079», «03361».

H3361.def: from «06965» and «05971»; (the) people will be raised; Jokmeam, a place in Palestine:--Jokmeam. Compare «03360», «03362».

H3362.def: from «06969» and «05971»; (the) people will be lamented; Jokneam, a place in Palestine:--Jokneam.

H3363.def: a primitive root; properly, to sever oneself, i.e. (by implication) to be dislocated; figuratively, to abandon; causatively, to impale (and thus allow to drop to pieces by rotting):--be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint.

H3364.def: a primitive root; to awake (intransitive):--(be) awake(-d).

H3365.def: a primitive root; properly, apparently, to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) valuable; causatively, to make rare (figuratively, to inhibit):--be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

H3366.def: from «03365»; value, i.e. (concretely) wealth; abstractly, costliness, dignity:--honour, precious (things), price.

H3368.def: from «03365»; valuable (obj. or subj.): -brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.

H3369.def: a primitive root; to ensnare (literally or figuratively):--fowler (lay a) snare.

H3370.def: from «03369»; insidious; Jokshan, an Arabian patriarch:--Jokshan.

H3371.et: probably from the same as (03348) and (0410)
H3371.def: probably from the same as «03348» and «0410»; veneration of God (compare «03354»); Joktheel, the name of a place in Palestine, and of one in Idumaea:--Joktheel.

H3372.def: a primitive root; to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten:--affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), × see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

H3374.def: feminine of «03373»; fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence:--X dreadful, × exceedingly, fear(-fulness).

H3375.def: from «03372»; fearfulness; Jiron, a place in Pal: -Iron.

H3376.def: from «03373» and «03050»; fearful of Jah; Jirijah, an Israelite:--Irijah.

H3377.def: from «07378»; he will contend; Jareb, a symbolical name for Assyria:--Jareb. Compare «03402».

H3378.def: from «07378» and «01168»; Baal will contend; Jerubbaal, a symbol. name of Gideon:--Jerubbaal.

H3379.def: from «07378» and «05971»; (the) people will contend; Jarobam, the name of two Israelite kings:--Jeroboam.

H3380.def: from «07378» and «01322»; shame (i.e. the idol) will contend; Jerubbesheth, a symbol. name for Gideon: -Jerubbesheth.

H3381.def: a primitive root; to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications); -X abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come(-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go(-ing) down(-ward), hang down, × indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

H3382.def: from «03381»; a descent; Jered, the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite:--Jared.

H3383.def: from «03381»; a descender; Jarden, the principal river of Palestine:--Jordan.

H3384.def: or (2 Chr. 26:15) yara; {yaw-raw'}; a primitive root; properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach:--(+) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach(-er,-ing), through.

H3385.def: from «03384» and «0410»; founded of God; Jeruel, a place in Palestine:--Jeruel.

H3386.def: perhaps denominative from «03394»; (born at the) new moon; Jaroach, an Israelite:--Jaroah.

H3387.def: from «03417»; green, i.e. an herb:--green thing.

H3388.def: or Yaruwshah {yer-oo-shaw'} feminine passive participle of «03423»; possessed; Jerusha or Jerushah, as Israelitess:--Jerusha, Jerushah.

H3389.pos:
Jerusalem = "teaching of peace"
  1. the chief city of Palestine and capital of the united kingdom and the nation of Judah after the split
H3389.et: a dual (in allusion to its two main hills [the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of (03390)]), probably from (the passive participle of) (03384) and (07999)
H3389.def: rarely Yruwshalayim {yer-oo- shaw-lah'-yim}; a dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of «03390»)); probably from (the passive participle of) «03384» and «07999»; founded peaceful; Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine:--Jerusalem.

H3391.et: from a unused root of uncertain signification
H3391.def: from a unused root of uncertain signification; a lunation, i.e. month:--month, moon.

H3392.def: the same as «03391»; Jerach, an Arabian patriarch:--Jerah.

H3394.def: from the same as «03391»; the moon:--moon. Yrechow. See «03405».

H3395.def: from «07355»; compassionate; Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites:--Jeroham.

H3396.def: from «07355» and «0410»; God will compassionate; Jerachmeel, the name of three Israelites:--Jerahmeel.

H3397.def: patronymically from «03396»; a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel:--Jerahmeelites.

H3398.def: probably of Egyptian origin; Jarcha, an Egyptian:--Jarha.

H3399.def: a primitive root; to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash:--be perverse, turn over.
